hero.subtitle: Welcome to
hero.title: Sofia Armony
hero.description: An oasis of peace and elegance, where every moment becomes a precious memory. Discover authentic comfort in the heart of nature.

about.title: A home away from home
about.desc1: Sofia Armony was born from a passion for authentic hospitality and the desire to offer our guests more than a simple place to sleep — a true relaxation experience.
about.desc2: Located in the heart of nature, a few steps from ski slopes and mountain trails, we pride ourselves on authentic cuisine, tastefully decorated rooms and a dedicated team that will treat you like family.
about.sincerity_desc: Every guest is welcomed with the warmth of a friend.
about.quality_desc: High standards for cleanliness, comfort and personalized services.
about.eco_desc: We use local products and ecological practices for a better future.

rooms.title: Our rooms
rooms.desc: Each room is designed with attention to offer the comfort and privacy you deserve.
rooms.classic_desc: Simple elegance with solid wood furniture, comfortable queen-size bed and private bathroom. Perfect for couples or solo travelers.
rooms.deluxe_desc: Spacious with separate living area, king-size bed, free-standing tub and private terrace with forest views.
rooms.suite_desc: Supreme experience: luxury bedroom and living room, private jacuzzi, fireplace and panoramic mountain views.

amenities.title: Facilities
amenities.desc: Complete facilities: Wi-Fi, Spa, Restaurant, Parking, Jacuzzi, Garden and many others.
amenities.garden_desc: Outdoor relaxation areas with beautiful views
amenities.spa_desc: Complete relaxation in our exclusive spa
amenities.breakfast_desc: Buffet breakfast with fresh local products
amenities.fireplace_desc: Relaxation room with fireplace for cold evenings
amenities.tour_desc: Discover local attractions with our guide

gallery.title: Photo Gallery
gallery.desc: A glimpse into our world — carefully designed spaces, unsurpassed nature and unforgettable moments.

reviews.title: Guest Reviews
reviews.desc: Our guests' stories are the best proof of the care we take to welcome them.

contact.title: Contact & Booking
contact.desc: We are here to help you plan the perfect stay. Write us or call us anytime!
contact.confirmation: Got it, {{name}}! We will confirm your booking within 2 hours by email or phone.

footer.desc: A destination where peace and elegance meet. We await you to discover authentic Romanian comfort.
